name: ai-factory
description: AI Factory: monorepo del hub (apps/api) y dashboard (apps/dashboard)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
